REQ-001.design_rationale: Sections 1.1 and 1.2 in design.md configure vaultwarden.storagePath: /opt/vaultwarden/data in charts/vinhthang-fleet/values.yaml and bind hostPath.path in charts/vinhthang-fleet/templates/vaultwarden.yaml to {{ .Values.vaultwarden.storagePath | default "/opt/vaultwarden/data" }} so the active pod mounts the production SQLite database containing thanghv@gmail.com and all 324 ciphers.
REQ-001.tasks_rationale: Task 1 updates values.yaml and vaultwarden.yaml with storagePath: /opt/vaultwarden/data, and Task 2 verifies that the pod mounts /opt/vaultwarden/data and serves thanghv@gmail.com (324 ciphers).
REQ-001.debate_rationale: ADR-0011 in decisions.md evaluates pros, cons/risks (normalizing UID 501:wheel ownership to root:root on arm10), and rejected alternatives (copying /opt/vaultwarden/data/* up into /opt/vaultwarden/ or enabling OIDC SSO), preserving module cohesion without arbitrary file size caps.

REQ-002.design_rationale: Sections 1.1 and 1.2 in design.md set signupsAllowed: false, invitationsAllowed: false, and websocketEnabled: true in values.yaml and template SIGNUPS_ALLOWED, INVITATIONS_ALLOWED, and WEBSOCKET_ENABLED with quote in vaultwarden.yaml; Section 2 verifies GET /api/config returns disableUserRegistration: true.
REQ-002.tasks_rationale: Task 1 sets signupsAllowed: false and invitationsAllowed: false in values.yaml and templates the env vars in vaultwarden.yaml; Task 2 verifies /api/config reports disableUserRegistration: true.
REQ-002.debate_rationale: ADR-0011 in decisions.md justifies enforcing single-user registration lockdown via Helm values and documents trade-offs and rejected alternatives.

REQ-003.design_rationale: Section 2 in design.md defines the declarative deployment flow via helm upgrade fleet ./charts/vinhthang-fleet after normalizing /opt/vaultwarden/data ownership on arm10, followed by prelogin verification on POST https://vault.vinhthang.dev/identity/accounts/prelogin and pod readiness checks in namespace apps.
REQ-003.tasks_rationale: Task 2 executes the declarative helm upgrade fleet ./charts/vinhthang-fleet deployment, GitOps commit/push, pod readiness check (1/1 Running in apps), and endpoint verification.
REQ-003.debate_rationale: ADR-0011 aligns with the mandatory Helm-only Kubernetes policy and evaluates operational risks and rejected alternatives.
